items.title: 8.10 Equilibrium ki position aur reaction ke halaat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.10, printed page 179.

blocks.text: Equilibrium ki position ka matlab hai equilibrium mixture mein products aur reactants ki ek doosre ke muqable miqdar.
Agar equilibrium par system ko chheda (disturb) jaye to:

items: Agar reactants ke muqable products ki concentration barh jaye to hum kehte hain ke equilibrium ki position right (products ki taraf) shift ho gayi.
Agar reactants ke muqable products ki concentration kam ho jaye to hum kehte hain ke equilibrium ki position left (reactants ki taraf) shift ho gayi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne dono baatein ulti likhi hain: products barhne par 'left' aur kam hone par 'right'. Sahi yeh hai: products barhein to position right (products ki taraf) shift hoti hai; products kam hon to left (reactants ki taraf).

blocks.prompt: Equilibrium par N₂, H₂ aur NH₃ ke mixture ko dabaya (compress kiya) jata hai aur ammonia ka hissa barh jata hai. Position kis taraf shift hui, aur kya Kc badla?
blocks.explanation: Right, yani products ki taraf, kyun ke ammonia barhi hai. Kc nahi badla: Kc sirf temperature se badalta hai; pressure ki tabdeeli ne concentrations is tarah badlin ke in se wahi Kc aata hai.

items: Equilibrium ki position: products aur reactants ki relative miqdar.
Right shift = zyada products; left shift = zyada reactants.
